name: Basement cleanup with printed PLA tools

mentions.name: Basement cleanup with printed PLA tools
mentions.description: A home cleanup project for a basement with a mold problem, using the 3D printer to produce cheap PLA tools that can be discarded if they get contaminated, so expensive tools don't have to be sacrificed to the mold.
mentions.source_excerpt: Starting on cleaning up a basement that resembles the Research floor from Control. Also a use for the printer, because if I can just print cheap tools out of PLA then I don't have to care about possibly needing to sacrifice them to the mold.
mentions.author: chaosharmonic
